name: My Friend's Hot Mom
source:
Three days. One forbidden woman. And a desire that could never be named.

Marina had caught Alex's attention long ago. Ever since his university days, she had remained in his memory as a woman he knew better than to look at for too long. The years never made that feeling disappear — it only grew quieter and deeper.

He is twenty-six. She is forty-six. She is his best friend's mother.

Then, one summer, he meets her again. What had remained little more than a forbidden thought for years suddenly feels dangerously close. Their conversations grow longer. Their glances linger. And the boundaries Alex built for himself begin to crumble faster than he can rebuild them.

Something grows between them that neither of them should name. And the further they go, the fewer ways back remain.

Make your choices. See how far you're willing to go. And discover what Marina truly wants when no one else is around.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5157300/My_Friends_Hot_Mom/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
三天时光，一位禁忌的女性，以及一份永远不该宣之于口的渴望。

早在很久以前，玛丽娜便已深深吸引了亚历克斯的目光。从大学时代起，她便一直留在他的记忆深处——一个他自知绝不该多看几眼的女人。岁月流逝并未冲淡那份悸动，反而让它在心底沉淀得愈发深沉静默。

他二十六岁，她四十六岁。而她是他挚友的母亲。

直到某个夏天，他与她再度重逢。多年来原本只停留在脑海里的禁忌念头，骤然间变得触手可及又危险万分。两人的交谈越来越长，交汇的目光久久不散，而亚历克斯为自己筑起的一道道心理防线，崩塌的速度远比他修补的速度更快。

某种两人都绝不该点破的情愫正在彼此之间悄然滋长。而他们越是往前迈步，留给彼此的退路便越是所剩无几。

做出你的抉择，看看你究竟愿意走到哪一步——并揭开当四下无人之时，玛丽娜心底真正渴求的是什么。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5157300/My_Friends_Hot_Mom/]Steam[/url]]
